candidates.name: ROLLING_CROSS_SECTIONAL_60M_COMPRESSION_EXPANSION
candidates.hypothesis: Fresh continuation is more likely when the last completed five-minute directional advance expands sharply relative to the instrument's preceding 55-minute normal range, separating a new impulse from an old 24-hour leader.
candidates.score: positive return of final completed 5m block / median normalized high-low range of the preceding eleven completed 5m blocks
rules: use exactly sixty completed one-minute bars ending at trigger time
aggregate them into twelve non-overlapping completed five-minute blocks
require a positive final five-minute block and compute one continuous expansion score
rank against completed scores in the trailing seven days, require at least 20 causal observations and percentile >= 0.60
preserve next-open execution, structural stop, solveQuantity quantity and all account protections
